text:
incidentbot: AUTO PAGE FAILED -> slack API 403 on send_page for prod-ingest. paging suppressed, queueing retries. tagging oncall.

alex: saw alerts but no pages. did oncall get notified?

maya: i didn't get a page. i'm oncall for ingest. checking logs now.

tomas: quick glance: slack app scopes show chat:write removed for bots after today's org admin consent sweep. 403 = insufficient_scope.

maya: ugh. admin rolled out 'remove legacy bot scopes' policy 09:08 UTC? that would explain it.

sarah: customers reporting delayed ingestion jobs, ~2-3% of events dropped/retried. severity low->med but could spike.

alex: sms fallback? last time SMS saved us. is it alive?

incidentbot: attempted sms fallback but sms-gateway returned 502 on last 6 attempts: "upstream read timeout". queued manual pages still blocked.

tomas: i can create a short-lived admin token with chat:write for incidentbot and re-inject. will do a 5m rollback after. prepping change.

ops-bot: Manual page channel open. use `/page-manual prod-ingest <msg>` for urgent until bot restored.

maya: commands i'll be running: `kubectl logs -n infra deployment/incidentbot | grep "403" -A3` and `curl -sS -X GET https://slack.com/api/apps.permissions.info -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" | jq .`

alex: i'll trigger manual pages for any incoming sev0s. ping me if you need me to ack.

jenny: support is pulling a list of customers who saw delayed processing. i'll DM the top 10 with status update template.

incidentbot: token re-injected (tomas). reconnected to slack, permissions validated: `chat:write` present. retrying queued pages (attempts 1..12).

maya: i see manual page delivered at 09:14 UTC, and new slack deliveries coming through. can folks confirm ack behavior?

alex: acked. got slack page and sms at 09:14:22 UTC.

sarah: metrics: ingestion error rate returned to baseline after ~8m. still some backlog; customers affected saw processing delays during the window. I've opened SEV tickets for top 3 customers.

tomas: root-cause summary: org-level app-scope cleanup removed bot write scope. mitigation: temporary token + re-grant. permanent actions: 1) pause org-wide auto-scope removals for incident apps; 2) incidentbot health alert for recurring 4xx from slack (>5/min); 3) add SMS gateway healthcheck + fallback verification in runbook.

maya: i'll file the postmortem and tag product/security. note: add a canary policy for app-scope rollouts and a pre-flight check that validates `chat:write` for paging apps.

alex: updating customers now. adding a quick note in #eng-oncall runbook that manual paging remains available until retro complete.

incidentbot: :white_check_mark: live mitigation complete, closing thread.

ops-bot: follow-ups: `#action` - tomas to create temporary policy exception, maya to open PM, jenny to finish customer comms.
